The Intelligence
 
 
 
 
 
Behind Personalization
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Meet Loomi, the intelligence platform that powers it all. It connects your data, channels, and teams to tailor every customer journey in real time.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
⁠First-Party 
Context
 
 
 
 
 
Loomi connects first-party customer and product data with business metrics and campaign performance to understand every customer in the context of your business.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Real-Time 
Decisioning
 
 
 
 
 
Customer intent changes in milliseconds. Loomi processes data and adapts the experience instantly (in 5ms–2s), so you never miss a moment.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
⁠Connected Orchestration
 
 
 
 
 
⁠From email and ads to search and shopping agents, Loomi connects seamlessly across channels, apps, and agents.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Meet Loomi
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shape Your Growth 
With Loomi 
 
 
 
 
 
See how our intelligence platform drives magical and measurable experiences for over 1,400 global brands.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Schedule a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI That Converts Email Sends Into Revenue
 
 
 
 
 
Loomi builds every email around the customer — the product they’ll want, the moment they’ll open, and the offer that pays. Not one blast for everyone.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
See How AI Email Works
 
 
 
 
 
 
Schedule a 30-Minute Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
drives

 with Loomi AI.
 
 
 
 
 
drives

 to its restaurants.
 
 
 
 
 
boosts 
conversion rate by +89%.

open rate by +40%.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
TRUSTED BY 1400+ BRANDS
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email Drives Interest, 
Intelligence Drives Impact
 
 
 
 
 
Loomi reads every signal, from customer behavior and loyalty to your live catalog and store stock, to recommend the next best product for each person — not just in email, but across every channel. And, it’s self-learning: Every open, click, and purchase sharpens the next send.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Driven by Intelligence
 
Batch & Blast
 
 
 
 
 
01
 
Send-time AI
 
 
 
Delivered at her usual open moment, not a 9 a.m. blast.
 
 
 
 
02
 
Intent
 
 
 
Subject written based on her trail-running behavior.
 
 
 
 
03
 
Live catalog + store stock
 
 
 
Personalized to match her size, her color, and what’s in stock near her.
 
 
 
 
04
 
Behavioral history
 
 
 
Her runs and mileage shape the recommendation.
 
 
 
 
05
 
Neural-net recs
 
 
 
The next products for someone with her stride.
 
 
 
 
 
 
01
 
No timing
 
 
 
Blasted at 9 a.m. to all 2.4M customers — no matter when anyone actually opens.
 
 
 
 
02
 
No intent
 
 
 
One subject line for everyone. It has no idea what a single shopper wants.
 
 
 
 
03
 
No catalog, no stock
 
 
 
"20% off sitewide" — the same offer for all. No size, no color, and nothing near you.
 
 
 
 
04
 
A first name isn't personalization
 
 
 
A merged first name is the only thing it personalizes. It has no idea what the customer browsed, bought, or when — so your VIP and a first-timer get the identical send.
 
 
 
 
05
 
Best-seller recs
 
 
 
Only features the store's top sellers — the same block everyone sees. It's blind to what customers actually browsed, so the recs never change.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It Starts With Email and Follows the Whole Journey
 
 
 
 
 
The email is just the first move. From there, Loomi decides the next best step across web, SMS, and ads — and knows when to stay quiet.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Day 1
 3:30 p.m.
 
 
Email
 
The AI email lands at Riley's typical open time — "Time for the Cloud Runner 3." She taps through.
 
 
 
 
Day 1
 3:34 p.m.
 
 
Website
 
She browses the shoe, checks her size, and buys the Cloud Runner 3.
 
 
 
 
Day 2
 
Supressed
 
 
Decisioning
 
She bought — so Loomi suppresses the retargeting ad. No paying to chase a customer you already won.
 
 
 
 
Day 3
 
 
Decisioning
 
Loomi lines up her next best action: gel packs, timed for when she'll run low.
 
 
 
 
Day 9
 
 
SMS · Ideal Channel
 
Her gel packs run low (~9 days). Riley receives one SMS nudge since that's her favored channel. She doesn't buy — Loomi only nudges once and never nags.
 
 
 
 
Day 12
 
 
Website
 
Riley returns on her own, and the homepage already features her gel-pack offer, ready when she is.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Channel interaction
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
In-session signal
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI decisioning
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Every Channel and Every Agent on One AI Platform
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization isn’t a campaign. It’s a decision made the instant your customer engages.
 
 
 
 
 
Most platforms orchestrate messages. Loomi orchestrates decisions — 
in real time
.
 
 
 
 
 
Meet Loomi
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
01
 
 
 
 
 
INTELLIGENCE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Grounded in Your Data
 
 
 
 
 
Every decision runs on your live data. Loomi acts on what your business actually knows — not a generic model.
 
 
 
 
 
Data warehouse · Orders & inventory · POS · Internal systems
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
02
 
 
 
 
 
DECISIONING
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Next Best Action
 
 
 
 
 
Loomi weighs every signal — behavior, context, and intent — and continuously picks the next best action for each customer.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
03
 
 
 
 
 
ACTIVATION
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
In the Moment
 
 
 
 
 
The decision goes live the instant it’s made — on whatever channel your customer is on — with no lag. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Every open, click, and purchase feeds back in to make each cycle sharper.

the number of customers you serve
 
 
 
 
 
 
the size of your product catalog
 
 
 
 
 
 
the number of events you execute – such as how many emails or SMS messages you send.

Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Your Bloomreach subscription consists of two parts: 
a module fee
 and 
a usage fee
. You only pay for the modules (e.g., email marketing) you wish to access. After choosing the module, your pricing is usage-based. The more the usage, the lower your per-unit price, so growing with Bloomreach is a win-win. Your base plan also comes with 
Loomi AI
, 
Bloomreach support
 and access to our 
documentation
 and 
best practice sessions
.
An annual subscription gives you flexibility and 
challenges Bloomreach to demonstrate our value
 year after year. 
We only win when our customers win.

 How much does Bloomreach cost? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Your Bloomreach subscription consists of two parts: 
a module fee
 and 
a usage fee
. You only pay for the modules (e.g., email marketing) you wish to access. After choosing the module, your pricing is usage-based. The more the usage, the lower your per-unit price, so growing with Bloomreach is a win-win. Your base plan also comes with 
Loomi AI
, 
Bloomreach support
 and access to our 
documentation
 and 
best practice sessions
.
An annual subscription gives you flexibility and 
challenges Bloomreach to demonstrate our value
 year after year. We only win when our customers win.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I only buy the channels and features I want? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
With Bloomreach, you start anywhere and build as you grow. All of our base plans are channel or module specific so you get the most out of the platform to solve for your immediate pain points. You only pay for the modules you want. Additional modules and upgrades can be purchased separately.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What happens if I have higher usage than I expect? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The product continues to work without upgrading, meaning there is no interruption to your marketing activities. Excess usage is charged separately. You can upgrade your contracted usage amount for better rates by contacting your rep.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I add other modules at any time? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yes! Our pricing is structured to allow you to grow at your own pace. As a customer, you will have a representative you can contact to get started with other modules as soon as you’re ready — without interruption to your current marketing activities.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you charge on a monthly or annual basis? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We bill on an annual basis to give you flexibility and challenge Bloomreach to demonstrate our value year after year. 99% of our customers continue to renew each year, leaning on Bloomreach to help them grow. If we aren’t providing value, we should lose your business 
—
 we only win when our customers win. We believe a year is an adequate amount of time for us to prove our value, although you can unlock even better rates with longer term agreements.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How quickly can I get started? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It depends on a product and your unique needs. Our platform allows you to scale your operations so you can start small, stay focused, and grow without having to add complexity to your tech stack.
For 
Marketing Automation
, our goal is to enable you to send hyper-targeted and personalized campaigns as soon as possible. It all depends on your unique needs and situation. For example, we’ve had customers get started in as little as a few weeks setting up a single channel, 
like our customer
 
Woolworths Metro60
. On average, our customers are actively using Bloomreach Engagement within 3 months as attested in the G2 2023 Comparisons and Ratings Report. Based on 
Forrester study from August 2024

 How much manual set-up is required? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We’ve served customers across every industry and have solutions for the most common challenges baked into our product, so tuning Bloomreach for your exact needs is a matter of configuration, rather than time-consuming (and expensive) customization.
Stop waiting around for a pixel to learn your customers’ behavior or for your merchandising team to diagnose and test rules. Take advantage of the largest ecommerce dataset out there to get an 
immediate edge over your competitors
 and generate more revenue, faster.  Due to the massive dataset we’ve built up over the last decade, our search engine and marketing automation already knows how to adapt to your customers’ behavior. 
Then, maintain that edge to keep improving revenue per visitor year-over-year.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What kind of support is available? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get support when you need it. We provide support spanning from implementation to practical use to strategic consulting.
Help is always a few keystrokes away and available through multiple channels, ensuring your team gets guidance during critical times. When you use Bloomreach Engagement (Marketing Automation platform), you can contact support directly in the app. With an average 2-minute response time, our support team provides prompt front-line support.
Our Strategic Experts and Business Consultants offer more than just standard support. They work closely with your business to identify new growth opportunities, help set up experiments and solutions, and provide tailored recommendations based on our extensive experience with other clients in your industry. This ensures you not only get the most out of our platform but also continue to scale and evolve.
Bloomreach also offers a number of valuable resources, including access to educational content on 
Bloo
